details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8437, 8485 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The /revalidate and /judge_resume cutoff handlers search only for ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V1 markers, so V2 state comments are never recognized as the last persisted state boundary.
  WHY: Once a V2 state write lands, $last_state_idx stays -1 and the same manual command is reprocessed on every poll cycle, causing repeated validation resets or resume loops.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~5768 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The stall-judge recent-comments filter excludes only ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V1 markers, so V2 state chunks pass through into the judge's context window.
  WHY: The judge prompt can be filled with truncated base64 state-dump fragments instead of recovery narrative or human guidance, which corrupts the decision context.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (~line 167), .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml (~line 219), .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml (~line 3208) | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The new regression test file tests/test_stall_loop_and_churn_fixes.py is not included in the explicit python3 tests/... allowlists.
  WHY: The stall-loop and churn-fix regressions never run in CI or the release gate, so future refactors can break them silently.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1692-1694 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: detect_stalls compares phase_attempts_count against the global max_recoveries instead of the phase-specific effective cap.
  WHY: For phases like ai:done that are meant to tolerate many recoveries, the skip action can trigger after only 5 phase attempts instead of the intended longer ladder.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3235-3238 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: _list_integration_conflict_files fetches branches without populating refs/remotes/origin/<branch>, then verifies those remote-tracking refs.
  WHY: On GitHub Actions checkouts the refs are absent, so the hot-file short-circuit returns 1 and the orchestrator falls back to the slower resolver path.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~5958-5962, ~6009 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: When MAX_JUDGE_REPLAY is exhausted, the synthesized escalate_human action is normalized back to a non-human fallback under the default configuration.
  WHY: With ENABLE_STALL_HUMAN_TERMINALIZATION=false, the replay cap does not actually force a human escalation, so the bad cached decision loop keeps cycling until the ordinary recovery budget is exhausted.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~5831-5835 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The judge decision cache key omits prompt inputs such as recent comments, mergeable state, and human guidance.
  WHY: The cache can replay a stale action across meaningful context changes for up to MAX_JUDGE_REPLAY cycles, wasting recovery budget.
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:247-255 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: cmd_extract disqualifies a manifest chain when the same sha256 manifest hash appears with a different declared total.
  WHY: A chunk-size or total-count change can reject a valid snapshot chain and force fallback to stale V1 data.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:116-130 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The review's concern that _looks_like_re_escape_output rejects valid re.escape output appears unfounded.
  WHY: The unescape-then-re.escape round-trip is a fixed point for re.escape outputs, so the heuristic is sound for the fingerprint use case.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8437, 8485 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Both the /revalidate handler and /judge_resume handler search only for ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V1 markers, so V2 state comments are never treated as the latest state boundary.
  WHY: After a V2 state write lands, $last_state_idx stays -1 and the same manual command is reprocessed on every poll cycle.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~5768 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The stall-judge prompt builder filters state-snapshot comments by checking only the ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V1 prefix, so V2 chunks pass through.
  WHY: Truncated base64 state data fills the judge's recent-comments context instead of recovery narrative or human guidance.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1692-1694 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: detect_stalls compares phase_attempts_count against the global max_recoveries instead of a phase-specific cap.
  WHY: ai:done-style phases can be skipped after only 5 attempts even when a larger phase allowance is intended.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (line ~167), .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml (line ~219), .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml (line ~3208) | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new test file tests/test_stall_loop_and_churn_fixes.py is not included in any explicit python3 tests/... allowlist.
  WHY: The regression tests for the stall-loop and churn fixes never execute in CI or the release gate.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3235-3238 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: git fetch uses bare branch names, but the next checks verify refs/remotes/origin/<branch>.
  WHY: On Actions runners the remote-tracking refs are absent or stale, so the hot-file short-circuit fails and the slower conflict resolver is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~5958-5962, ~6009 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The forced escalate_human path for MAX_JUDGE_REPLAY is normalized away under the default terminalization setting.
  WHY: With ENABLE_STALL_HUMAN_TERMINALIZATION=false, the replay cap does not actually break out of a bad cached decision loop.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~5831-5835 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The judge decision cache key is too narrow.
  WHY: It ignores tracking comments and other prompt-shaping inputs, so stale decisions can replay across meaningful context changes.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~5768 (same filter as finding #2) | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The same V1-only filter also lets V2 state chunks occupy the stall-judge diagnostics window.
  WHY: The last-8-comments blob passed to the judge can become truncated state-dump noise instead of the actual recovery timeline.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:116-130 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The round-trip heuristic in _looks_like_re_escape_output appears to be a false positive concern.
  WHY: Direct analysis shows re.escape outputs remain fixed points after unescaping and re-escaping for the fingerprint use case.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:160-215 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new test file tests/test_stall_loop_and_churn_fixes.py is not included in the explicit python3 tests/... allowlist.
  WHY: The regression tests covering the stall-loop, integration-churn, and wave narration fixes will never execute in CI.
- .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml:212-225 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR adds tests/test_stall_loop_and_churn_fixes.py but omits it from the mark-stable.yml unit-test allowlist.
  WHY: Release-gate regression coverage for MAX_BUDGET_NEUTRAL_OVERRIDES, MAX_JUDGE_REPLAY, exponential backoff, and wave narration suppression is never exercised.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3201-3214 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new test file tests/test_stall_loop_and_churn_fixes.py is absent from the release-gate allowlist.
  WHY: The churn/stall loop regression guards have zero CI coverage in the critical release path.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8437, 8485 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The /revalidate and /judge_resume cutoff handlers still search only for ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V1 markers.
  WHY: After a V2 state write, $last_state_idx stays -1 so stale manual commands are reprocessed on every poll cycle.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~1122 and ~5768 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The stall-judge prompt builder filters out state snapshots only when the body starts with ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V1.
  WHY: V2 chunks pass through and truncated base64 state-dump fragments get fed into the judge context instead of recovery or human narrative.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1692-1694 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: detect_stalls compares phase_attempts_count directly against raw max_recoveries, bypassing the phase-specific cap.
  WHY: ai:done stalls with MAX_STALL_RECOVERIES_DONE=99 can be incorrectly skipped after only 5 phase attempts.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3212-3246 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: git fetch uses bare branch names but subsequent git rev-parse checks refs/remotes/origin/<branch>.
  WHY: On Actions checkouts the remote-tracking refs may be absent, causing the hot-file short-circuit to return 1 and forcing the fallback resolver path.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5958-5962 and 6009 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When MAX_JUDGE_REPLAY is exceeded and the cache forces escalate_human, the action is normalized through a path that rejects terminal escalation when ENABLE_STALL_HUMAN_TERMINALIZATION=false.
  WHY: With the default setting, hitting the replay cap does not actually force human escalation and the cached bad decision keeps cycling.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
